description: Search official DS Platform specifications, guides, wiki pages, contracts, and examples by keyword, category, and spec version (DS2-SPEC-V2.0 default or DS2-SPEC-V1.1). Accepts optional query (equivalent aliases: q, keyword, search, term; empty query lists top public documents), category, version, and limit. Use first to discover matching document_id values before calling docs_read; use dsdx.examples.list to browse starter .ds2 files or dsdx.library.search for 3D equipment models.

includeCategories.description: Include Diataxis category descriptors (default: false in summary view)

limit.description: Maximum number of matching sections to return (default: 15, max: 50)

query.description: Optional search query keyword or phrase across canonical repository docs, grammar, contracts, examples, and wiki (omit, empty, or '*' returns full Diataxis catalog)

version.description: Target documentation/language version ('DS2-SPEC-V1.1' / 'ds2/v1' or 'DS2-SPEC-V2.0' / 'ds2/v2'; omit or 'latest' for V2-first search with explicitly labelled legacy references)

name: docs_search

error.description: Structured error payload when status != OK
